tools.name: array_plan
tools.label: Choose solo or split
tools.description: Declare one task choice. Solo keeps implementation with you. Split declares two or more independent parts, each with a contract, then start every part immediately with array_delegate. The host replies with ownership overlap, partial registered coverage and unowned check files; it posts a visible line and records the choice. A one-part split is accepted with advice; no plan refuses delegation. Available only to experimental Claude Managed leads.
tools.promptSnippet: Choose solo or split once per task.

contract.description: owns, shared, mustNotTouch, checks, decisions: string lists; costLimit, report: strings. Paths checkout-relative. Overlap with live siblings is advice in the result.
